# Cambium Research Platform
> The Enterprise Research Operating System for Modern Scholarship

## Overview
Cambium is an AI-powered Research Opportunity Discovery and Intelligence Platform. It aggregates global research funding (grants, fellowships, conferences, calls for papers) and indexes 250M+ open scientific publications across OpenAlex, Cornell arXiv, Crossref, and DOAJ.

## Core Capabilities
- **Opportunity Discovery**: Real-time aggregation of active RFPs from NSF, NIH, Horizon Europe, and foundations, paired with 1536-dimensional semantic similarity vector search.
- **AI Autocomplete Engine**: Sub-20ms real-time ghost text and query completion using local RAG caching and Gemini 1.5 Flash.
- **Academic Social & Community**: Scholar-to-scholar connections, hypothesis discussions, and preprint review feeds.
- **Research Workspace**: Integrated literature synthesis, citation management, BibTeX/RIS export, and project collaboration.
- **Institutional Compliance & Audit**: Cryptographic SHA-256 audit ledger, CRediT contributor taxonomy tracking, and SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On.

## Architecture
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, W3C DTCG Living Materials tokens.
- **Backend**: NestJS 10 Enterprise API, TypeORM, BullMQ, Redis 7.
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (1536-dim HNSW cosine indexing).
